India's Forex Reserves Reach Record High, RBI Supports Rupee

India's foreign exchange reserves have reached a record high, according to reports. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is reportedly increasing its support for the rupee, a move which is seen as being facilitated by the strengthened forex reserves. The central bank's measures are credited with contributing to this record accumulation of reserves.
